long_biography.plain_text:
EuroChem and SUEK became Andrey Melnichenko's defining industrial projects through an acquisition strategy that joined fragmented plants and mines into larger groups. Working with Sergei Popov, he combined dozens of transactions across fertilisers, coal and steel pipes, then concentrated on EuroChem and SUEK after the partnership was divided.

The companies were developed as vertically integrated operations. EuroChem linked mineral extraction, fertiliser manufacture and distribution through to farm delivery, while SUEK developed around large-scale thermal-coal production. The Andrey Melnichenko Foundation funds regional education infrastructure and programmes concerned with food security and climate action.
